title: DR1 puts a 'Change number of animals' link on each species panel; the frontend gives a person no way to correct the count from the identification page.

finding.frontend: Each commodity line gets a plain heading — 'Cow (0102) — Bos taurus' — and immediately below it the entry counter and fields. A person who realises the count is wrong while entering the fourth of six animals has no link to correct it; the counter and the record cap are both driven by the number of animals answered earlier, and the only way back is the Back link. The card heading is rendered with no accompanying action at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/_identification-card.njk:9-10.
finding.prototype: Every species panel in DR1 opens with a header bar carrying the species name on the left and a 'Change number of animals' link on the right, going to the consignment-details page where every count was set (app/views/animal-identification-details.html:93-98). The link is on every panel, and it is the same link on every panel: it names no species and carries no return, so wherever the person clicks it they land on the consignment-details page with all the counts on it and find their own way back.
finding.difference: Add a link beside each card heading that returns to the consignment-details page where numberOfAnimals is answered. DR1's link is a bare href to that page — no species parameter, no change context and no return — so matching DR1 needs nothing more than the link. Carrying a change context so the person comes back to the identification page would be an improvement on DR1 rather than parity with it; decide that separately. Worth doing after the Selected commodities block, because that block already carries the count per line and the two together are what makes the page correctable.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a link on the frontend's identification card that returns to the number-of-animals answer, or a DR1 species panel rendered without the change-count link.
finding.correction: Claimed that because the link is on every panel, 'on a multi-species consignment the person changes the count for the species they are looking at', and that the frontend work includes 'carrying the change context so the person comes back to the identification page'. Both overstate DR1. Every panel renders the identical markup at app/views/animal-identification-details.html:96 — href="/consignment-details" with no species id, no query and no return parameter — and the captured DOM confirms exactly one 'Change number of animals' link resolving to /consignment-details. DR1 targets nothing and returns nowhere. The prototype and difference slots are rewritten to say so; the finding itself stands, since the frontend has no such link at all.

relatedTo.why: both restore a route out of the identification page back to the commodity answers
